items.t: Anthropic short interest climbs as IPO lockup expiry nears
items.sum: Investing.com -- Short sellers have been building positions in Anthropic since the artificial intelligence company went public on November 18, with the number of shares on loan rising to around 55 million, equal to 0.42% of total shares outstanding, according to S&P Global data.

items.t: George Soros and 8 Other Big Funds Sold S&P Global Last Quarter, While 12 Bought. Who’s Right?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 12 bought S&P Global and 9 sold it, George Soros’ fund among the sellers. The buyers put far more money behind the stock: Evergreen Quality Fund’s add alone was bigger than all nine sales combined.
